slides.title: 83% of Cyber Offers Are Negotiable
slides.subtitle: Most candidates accept the first number

bullets: Research market rate before you respond
Counter with a specific number, not a range
Negotiate benefits - not just base salary
Silence after your ask is completely normal

caption: The offer on the table is rarely the best they can do. Most cyber candidates never push back - and leave real money on the table. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #salarynegotiation #cypherjobs #careertips
